design.method: L-shaped heightfield outside existing V58 scenic extension. bx=min(x,135),by=max(y,-135), base=exact boundary vertex height, d=hypot(x-bx,y-by),t=min(d/40,1),z=base+t*t*(3-2*t)*(12+2.5*sin((x+y)*.055)+1.5*cos((x-y)*.037)); cells x>=135 or y<-135. Authored noncanonical ridge.

native.method: Exact old boundary UV/color, new copied material, original shader at zero blend seam, 25m smooth transition into two world-projected PBR shaders with separate UV/tangent normal maps and macro albedo modulation. Not the same as standalone baked atlas. No old mesh/material edits. Two diagnostic cameras.
